review_candidates.description: Description Role: Postdoctoral Research Associate in the Comparative Political Economy of Market Competition Grade and Salary: Grade 7 - £37,694 - £47,389 per annum FTE and working pattern: Full Time (1FTE), Fixed Term for 33 months Holiday Entitlement: 33 days annual leave plus 9 buildings closed days (and Christmas Eve when it falls on a weekday) Markets Under Siege: How Geoeconomic Competition Undermines Free Markets Based at Panmure House, Edinburgh. Reporting to Professor Adam Dixon, Adam Smith Chair (Principal Investigator). The Project About Markets Under Siege investigates why liberal democracies increasingly depart from free market principles when facing competitive pressure from China, often on the basis of simplified narratives about Chinese “state capitalism” that may not align with the accumulated empirical evidence. The project runs for 33 months and comprises three research components operating in parallel, each led by a postdoctoral researcher and integrated through monthly team meetings and quarterly integration workshops: Component 1 — Mechanisms of Justification for Geoeconomic Intervention: systematic mapping of the rhetorical strategies and institutional mechanisms through which liberal democracies justify departures from market principles. Component 2 — Systematic Evidence Review on Market Competition: systematic literature review and meta-analysis of evidence on competitive dynamics in Chinese and Western markets. Component 3 — Intellectual History of Liberal Market Principles Under Competitive Pressure: analysis of how liberal thinkers from Adam Smith to the Cold War liberals understood the relationship between international competition and market freedom. The project launches in 2026, the 250th anniversary of the publication of The Wealth of Nations, and includes an international workshop series in Edinburgh, Washington DC, Asia and London. Planned outputs include seven to nine peer-reviewed articles, policy briefs, public essays and a project monograph. The posts are designed to give early-career scholars substantial autonomy and first-authorship opportunities within a coordinated collective endeavour: each postholder leads the design and delivery of their component’s research, publishes from it, and contributes actively to the integration of findings across components. The posts also carry a significant engagement dimension, including delivery of the workshop series, policy briefs and public-facing outputs. Supervision is provided through biweekly one-to-one meetings with the Principal Investigator, alongside mentorship in publication strategy and peer review. Maintain transparent and reproducible research records, including search protocols, coding frameworks and analytical decisions. Publication and dissemination Lead the drafting of approximately two to three peer-reviewed articles from the component, and contribute as co-author to cross-component publications. Comparative Political Economy of Market Competition This post leads Component 2, a systematic literature review and meta-analysis of existing research on competitive dynamics in Chinese and Western markets. Your Role The Energy Latin America and Caribbean team comprises 12 investment professionals (including this vacancy) and is responsible for the sourcing, execution, and supervision of all debt-related energy investments in the Latin America and Caribbean region. The team is responsible for a growing portfolio of around 30 clients and circa EUR 720 million exposure and is supported by a team of environmental, social, insurance, legal and compliance specialists. This team is looking for an enthusiastic Associate. In this role, you will be primarily involved in the portfolio management of our growing loan portfolio, while providing selective support to the execution of new and repeat transactions. This role requires (strong) financial analytical skills, financial modelling skills, risk awareness, a general understanding of financial markets and economic trends, and good communication and writing skills. Specific Tasks Include Analyzing operational and financial reporting and data of existing clients (e.g., financial performance, compliance with covenants, assessment of forecasts, etc.); Writing reports and managing internal processes related to monitoring the performance of existing clients (annual reviews, change requests, waivers, restructurings etc.); Preparing market and financial analyses of clients, sectors and countries, including the evaluation of project finance structures, key risk factors, debt service capacity and financial projections; Supporting (Senior) Portfolio Officers in managing relationships with these clients on an operational working level. Closely monitoring clients in the quarterly watchlist process; Participating in client visits when required (requiring international travel); Supporting the business development team in processing repeat transactions with existing clients. Managing internal systems and the processing and filing of customer data, including KYC, ESG, Impact, financials, legal and insurance documentation. Collaborating closely with colleagues in a multidisciplinary deal team setting (e.g., Environmental & Social Officers, Corporate Governance Officers, Know Your Customer Administrators, etc.). Contributing to departmental projects as requested. Our Offer For This Position We Offer You Gross yearly salary ranging from EUR 55-65K (based on 40 hours/ week, including 8% holiday allowance and 13th month) depending on your seniority, years of relevant experience, and background . Working hours: 40 hours per week Pension scheme, partly paid by FMO. 31 holidays Hybrid way of working (50/50). Working remotely abroad for maximum 60 days in a rolling period of 12 months. For more information, please visit our website Secondary Benefits - FMO Your Team The Energy sector has been prioritized by FMO as one of three strategic sectors under Strategy 2030 which aims to contribute to SDG7 and SDG13. FMO is a leading financier in the energy sector in emerging markets. Next to financing energy generation projects (mainly solar, wind, and hydropower) and distributed energy solutions, FMO is broadening its energy scope further in segments that are critical to realize a zero-carbon energy transition pathway and supply chain. The department comprises about 55 professionals focusing on senior debt and mezzanine finance. FMO aims to build a substantial portfolio of sustainable investments that realize steady and market-driven returns. The department has four regional teams servicing our target markets: Eastern & Southern Africa (ESAF), West & North Africa and Middle East (WA/MENA), Asia & Eastern Europe (Asia/ECA), and Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC). Your Background Master’s degree in Economics, Finance, Business Administration, or Engineering. Minimum of 3 years of relevant working experience in financial analysis, portfolio analysis, project finance, or corporate finance, preferably in the energy infrastructure sector. review_candidates.description: About Us Outward Bound Hong Kong (OBHK) is a non-profit and a leading outdoor educational organization that uses experiential learning to help young people discover and develop their potential. We are part of an international network delivering courses in 37 countries. Through our fundraising efforts, we provide opportunities for young people from less privileged backgrounds to participate in our life-changing programmes. Our ambition is to ensure that no one misses the opportunity to recognize and develop their full potential because of financial constraints. After more than 50 years of serving Hong Kong, OBHK is well known among our supporters, alumni and parts of the wider community. As communication and marketing continue to evolve, we are looking for a creative, hands-on and highly organized professional to strengthen our digital presence, tell our stories and engage our audiences across multiple platforms. The Role The Assistant Marketing Communications Manager / Senior Marketing Communications Executive will be responsible for planning and delivering integrated marketing, communications and engagement activities across social media, email, website, podcast, exhibitions and events. This is a broad, hands-on role suited to an all-rounded marketer and strong content creator who can develop compelling stories, manage projects from concept to completion, work effectively with internal and external stakeholders, and confidently manage multiple channels and deadlines. The successful candidate will help communicate OBHK's impact and value to participants, alumni, community organizations, corporate partners, funders, donors and the wider public. Primary Roles & Responsibilities Marketing and Communications Develop and implement integrated marketing and communications plans that align with OBHK’s organisational objectives. Create and manage high-quality content for social media, eDMs, website, newsletters, marketing materials, presentations and other communication channels. Develop compelling written, visual and multimedia content that communicates OBHK’s programmes, impact, stories and fundraising needs. Manage OBHK’s social media platforms, including content planning, copywriting, publishing, community engagement and performance monitoring. Build and maintain an annual and monthly content calendar across relevant channels. Ensure brand consistency, accuracy and appropriate tone across all communications. Support media relations, publicity initiatives, press releases and communications with external stakeholders where required. Social Media and Digital Engagement Take ownership of day-to-day social media management and audience engagement. Develop engaging content formats, campaigns and storytelling approaches suitable for different platforms. Monitor social media trends, audience behavior and platform developments, and recommend opportunities to improve reach and engagement. Track and report on key performance indicators, including reach, engagement, audience growth, website traffic and campaign results. Support digital marketing activities, including SEO, paid social and online campaigns where appropriate. eDM and Website Management Plan, write, design and distribute monthly eDMs and other email communications. Manage email databases, mailing lists, audience segmentation and campaign reporting. Update and maintain the OBHK website, including page content, images, events, programme information and campaign materials. Ensure website content is accurate, up to date, user-friendly and aligned with the organization's brand and communications priorities Podcast Production Manager Coordinate the podcast production process from concept development to publication. Develop episode themes, content plans, interview briefs and production schedules. Liaise with hosts, guests, editors, designers, production houses and other external suppliers. Manage production timelines, approvals, budgets and deliverables. Coordinate the preparation of supporting materials, including episode descriptions, social media content, website updates and eDM promotions. Ensure podcast episodes are published and promoted effectively across appropriate channels Events, Engagement and Exhibition Marketing Coordinate event communications, invitations, registration, venue arrangements, suppliers, promotional materials and post-event follow-up. Support the planning and execution of exhibitions, expos and other public-facing marketing activities. Manage expo displays, including booth concepts, production, logistics, promotional materials, signage, collateral and on-site coordination. Work with internal teams and external suppliers to ensure events and exhibitions are delivered professionally, on time and within budget. Evaluate event and exhibition performance and recommend improvements for future activities. Project and Stakeholder Management Manage multiple marketing and communications projects simultaneously from planning through to completion. Prepare project plans, schedules, budgets, briefs and status updates. Coordinate cross-functional projects with colleagues across the organization. Build effective working relationships with internal departments, partners, suppliers, production houses, agencies and other external stakeholders. Identify opportunities for partnerships and collaborations that can increase awareness of OBHK and its social impact. Ensure projects are delivered to a high standard, on schedule and within budget. Marketing Intelligence and Reporting Stay informed about relevant marketing, communications, social media, content and event trends. Provide insights and recommendations to improve brand awareness, audience engagement, participation and fundraising support. Prepare regular reports and evaluations on campaign, social media, eDM, website, podcast, event and exhibition performance. Use data and audience feedback to optimize future marketing activities. Required Skills and Experience Values-driven, with a genuine desire to support the mission, vision and values of Outward Bound Hong Kong. Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Media, Events or a related discipline. Approximately 4–6 years of relevant experience in marketing, communications, content creation, digital marketing, events or a related field. Candidates with more or less experience may be considered depending on suitability. Demonstrated experience managing social media platforms and creating content that generates audience engagement. Strong content creation, copywriting and storytelling skills across social media, email, website and other communication channels. Experience managing monthly eDM campaigns, preferably using platforms such as Mailchimp, HubSpot or similar tools. Practical experience managing websites and using Wix or similar website editing platforms. Experience in podcast production or project management, including working with production houses, editors or other external suppliers. Experience in exhibition, expo or event marketing, including display planning, supplier coordination and on-site execution. Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, timelines, budgets and stakeholders. Good creative judgement and the ability to develop engaging concepts, copy and visual content. Good understanding of digital marketing, including social media, SEO, paid social, email marketing and website analytics. Familiarity with relevant marketing and digital tools, such as Google Analytics, HubSpot, Canva, Adobe Creative Cloud or similar platforms, is an advantage. Excellent command of written and spoken English and Chinese. Independent, organized, detail-oriented and commercially aware, with a positive and practical “can-do” attitude. Outgoing, energetic, cheerful, authentic and patient, with the ability to work collaboratively across different departments. Willingness to work outside normal office hours when required for events, exhibitions or programme-related activities. Willingness and ability to work in the Sai Kung area. Compensation and Benefits Medical insurance coverage Lunch is provided while working on the base 5-day work week Meaningful work in support of youth development and social impact Opportunities to work across marketing, communications, digital content, events and community engagement Work in the beautiful Sai Kung area, surrounded by nature To apply, please email a cover letter, CV/resume with expected salary and availability to: recruitment@outwardbound.org.hk Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
